held.title: Battery level formula is not clamped to 0–100 %.
held.body: The straight line `(v - 3.3f) / 0.9f * 100` goes past 100 % when the cell reads above 4.2 V, which is normal while charging on USB or from ADC error. It goes negative between 2.5 V and 3.3 V. Home Assistant's Battery Level and the top-bar icon would then show values like 105 % or -20 %. I couldn't see `features/battery-voltage.yaml`, so this only applies if that file doesn't clamp the formula's result. If it doesn't, clamp it in the formula: `(v < 2.5f ? NAN : clamp((v - 3.3f) / (4.2f - 3.3f) * 100.0f, 0.0f, 100.0f))`. This needs `std::clamp`, or write the same thing with `fminf`/`fmaxf`.
